description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - The National Association for the Sport of Scrabble, of which the registration was cancelled
categorisation: This gazette content involves the re-establishment of a regulation under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks (specifically the reinstatement of a cancelled sports federation registration through ministerial power vested by law). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
